items.name: Boot Vault
items.depicts: A massive circular green-phosphor bank vault door with twelve perimeter bolts, heavy right-hand hinges, and a three-spoke locking wheel.
items.concept: hardware root of trust and locked boot ROM

items.name: ROM Rack
items.depicts: A tall green-phosphor equipment rack housing four stacked DIP-pinned ROM cartridges beneath a black panel of eight blinking indicator bars.
items.concept: system ROM bank and firmware volume storage

items.name: Variable Chest
items.depicts: A three-by-two bank of six dark green metal drawers, each fitted with a bright horizontal pull.
items.concept: UEFI firmware variable store and NVRAM partitions

items.name: Pocket Vault
items.depicts: A miniature circular green vault door with a three-spoke wheel and a single right-hand hinge.
items.concept: sealed firmware storage compartment

items.name: Port 80 Oracle
items.depicts: A dark green rectangular bezel holding a two-digit seven-segment LED readout glowing bright green.
items.concept: power-on self-test diagnostic codes

items.name: SPI Flash
items.depicts: A small green ten-pin dual-inline chip package with a bright square pin-one orientation dot.
items.concept: SPI NOR flash memory chip

items.name: Write-Protect Lock
items.depicts: A sturdy green phosphor padlock with a bright crossbar and a dark warded keyhole.
items.concept: BIOS flash write-protection lock

items.name: CMOS Cell
items.depicts: A round green coin-cell battery held by four retainer tabs with a bright plus sign stamped in the center.
items.concept: CR2032 CMOS battery backing RTC and BIOS settings

items.name: Press F2
items.depicts: A wide dark-green terminal panel with an inverted header bar above the pixel-art word BOOT.
items.concept: pre-boot BIOS/UEFI setup utility menu

items.name: Boot Order
items.depicts: A small green-framed rectangle standing on two stubs with three dark and light blocks arranged inside.
items.concept: UEFI boot device priority order

items.name: DIP Bank
items.depicts: A green four-position DIP switch block with three toggles pushed up and the third pushed down.
items.concept: hardware configuration DIP switches

items.name: PWM Fan
items.depicts: A square dark-green chassis fan housing with four corner screw holes and a four-blade spinning rotor.
items.concept: firmware-controlled PWM chassis cooling fan

items.name: Firmware Capsule
items.depicts: A green-bordered rectangular module with bottom pins and a bright padlock emblem centered in a dark recess.
items.concept: cryptographically signed UEFI capsule firmware update

items.name: SOIC Clip
items.depicts: A green test clip clamped over a dark chip body, with two probe leads extending from the top and four pins below.
items.concept: SOIC-8 SPI test clip for external firmware flashing

items.name: Option ROM
items.depicts: A dark-green expansion circuit board with bottom edge-connector fingers and one large bright chip beside two smaller ICs.
items.concept: PCI/ISA expansion card Option ROM

items.name: POST Beeper
items.depicts: A small dark-green circular piezo speaker with a bright green cross aperture positioned to emit animated sound pulses.
items.concept: motherboard PC speaker POST beep codes

items.name: Reset Switch
items.depicts: A bright green rounded tactile switch set into a dark green square housing.
items.concept: hardware reset vector and cold-reset line

items.name: POST Card
items.depicts: A dark-green plug-in circuit card with bottom edge-connector pins, a bright LED, and a two-character readout showing BF.
items.concept: plug-in ISA/PCI POST diagnostic analyzer card

items.name: ACPI Seal
items.depicts: A green circular standby-power icon formed by a broken ring and a vertical line at the top.
items.concept: ACPI power states and firmware tables

items.name: Microcode EPROM
items.depicts: A green ten-pin DIP chip with a central circular quartz window revealing the dark silicon die inside.
items.concept: CPU microcode patch and UV-erasable EPROM

items.name: NVRAM Cells
items.depicts: Four vertical dark-green memory columns with bright caps standing on a shared bus, three filled high and one low.
items.concept: non-volatile RAM variable storage

items.name: Boot Floppy
items.depicts: A miniature green 3.5-inch floppy disk with a top sliding shutter, bottom label, and corner notch.
items.concept: removable BIOS recovery and boot floppy disk

items.name: Platform Key
items.depicts: A horizontal green skeleton key with a cross-slotted circular bow on the left and two warded teeth on the right.
items.concept: UEFI Platform Key and cryptographic root signing key

items.name: TPM Chip
items.depicts: A square green-bordered chip housing a small padlock with a bright shackle and a dark keyhole.
items.concept: Trusted Platform Module security coprocessor

items.name: JTAG Header
items.depicts: A black-centered green rectangular shroud containing two rows of five square pin contacts.
items.concept: 10-pin JTAG hardware boundary-scan and debug header

items.name: Secure Boot
items.depicts: A green stepped heraldic shield enclosing a dark field with a bright horizontal bar in the center.
items.concept: UEFI Secure Boot signature verification

items.name: UART Header
items.depicts: A rectangular green-framed black header with three square pins in a row, the leftmost glowing bright green.
items.concept: 3-pin serial UART debug console header

items.name: Watchdog Timer
items.depicts: A dark-green framed monitor holding a bright horizontal bar approaching a vertical threshold line on the right.
items.concept: hardware watchdog timer (WDT)

items.name: Phosphor Pacer
items.depicts: A hovering green-phosphor rectangular module with bright upper and lower plates and a central visor that blinks dark and light.
items.concept: UEFI Boot Services polling daemon and firmware supervisor
